text:
(ESA 2025) Choose the correct use of the infinitive or gerund to complete the dialogue.


NCO Academy student: "Good morning, Sir"
Sergeant Major: "Why are you awake in uniform so early? Today is your day off. You can ___(sleep)___ until seven o’clock today. It’s worth ___(stay)___ in bed a little longer to recover from the exhausting week."
NCO Academy student: "I enjoy ___(learn)___ foreign languages, so I woke up early ___(study)___ English."
Sergeant Major: I’m really proud of ___(see)___ you working so hard.
options: You can "to sleep" until seven o’clock.
It’s worth "to stay" in bed a little bit longer.
I’m really proud of "to see" you working hard.
subject: Inglês
explanation:
(A) Errado.
Após modal verbs (como can, must, should), o verbo vem sem “to”.
Correto: You can sleep until seven o'clock.

(B) Errado.
Depois de worth, o verbo deve vir no gerúndio, não no infinitivo.
Correto: It's worth staying in bed a little bit longer.

(C) Correto
enjoy verbo de preferência pessoal, após verbo de preferência pessoal usamos o "learning"

(D) Errado.
A forma correta seria to learn English, pois para indicar propósito (motivo da ação), usa-se to + verbo (I woke up early to learn English).

(E) Errado.
Após a expressão proud of, usa-se gerúndio (verb + ing), não o infinitivo.
Correto: proud of seeing you working hard.
